newsitem.title: USA: COMSAT cuts rates on digital network service.
newsitem.headline: COMSAT cuts rates on digital network service.

text.p: COMSAT Corp will lower rates on two categories of digital private communications network services -- international business service and very small aperture terminal service.

The rate reductions average approximately eight percent for international business service and 10 percent for very small aperture terminal service, depending on the length of the lease and the amount of bandwidth used, COMSAT said in a statement on Monday. Very small aperture terminal service is for low-to medium speed data transfers and private line voice and data communications, COMSAT said.
COMSAT said it is capping rates at current or reduced levels for three years after reclassification.
Rate reductions are effective July 1, 1997, pending FCC approval.
